data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as it ends.

**Target:** A **HERETIC ASTARTES** unit of yours, if it was **eligible to fight** in the phase.

**Effect:** If the unit is not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit, it can carry out a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) of at most 6", or at most 12" for a **MOUNTED** unit. Otherwise, it can carry out a [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back). If the unit [disembarked](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) this turn from a **TRANSPORT**, it cannot [embark](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) in a **TRANSPORT** as that move ends.
